newsitem.title: USA: Eaton promotes CFO Adrian Dillon.
newsitem.headline: Eaton promotes CFO Adrian Dillon.

text.p: The board of Eaton Corp has promoted Adrian Dillon to the position of executive vice president-chief financial and planning officer, effective April 25, the company said Friday.
Dillon has been vice president and chief financial and planning officer since September 1995, the company said.

Dillon is a member of Eaton's senior management council and worldwide business team, two groups that manage the daily operations of Eaton, a global manufacturer of engineered products that had $7 billion in sales in 1996.
